name: How long does window leak repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window leak repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for window leak repair varies depending on the severity and complexity of the leak. Minor re-sealing might take a few hours. More extensive repairs involving frame damage, flashing replacement, or exterior wall work could take one to several days. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring a lasting solution to prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; minor re-sealing takes hours, while complex issues involving frame or flashing can take one to several days, depending on severity.
